claims.text: POL-NS-01 makes the fee chargeable only if all four limbs hold, and limb (b) fails outright. POL-NS-02 defines arrival as at least 3 consecutive position fixes inside the arrival radius of the pickup pin, for this trip 120 m because trip_record records pickup_zone_class LARGE_VENUE. The driver's trace contains 0 qualifying in-geofence fixes and 0 qualifying fix count, so the driver was never inside that radius at any point in the 15 minutes before he cancelled at 13:10:30. On POL-NS-02's own terms the driver never arrived, limb (b) fails, and the rider is entitled to a full refund of the cancellation fee.

The distance is not marginal or borderline. Every one of the driver's 34 fixes sits 219.77 m from the pickup pin (min 219.77 m, max 219.77 m, mean 219.77 m) at a reported speed of 0.0 km/h, which is roughly 100 m outside the 120 m arrival radius POL-NS-02 sets for LARGE_VENUE shopping-mall pickup zones such as this one. There is no reading of the trace on which the driver was at the pickup pin, and the GPS measurement is complete (coverage_pct 100.0).

Limb (c) of POL-NS-01 fails independently of limb (b). The driver's longest qualifying in-geofence run is 0.0 seconds, with 0 qualifying fixes and dwell_start_offset_sec null, against the 300-second minimum dwell that POL-NS-01 and POL-NS-06 fix for LARGE_VENUE. The driver did not hold position inside the geofence for any part of the waiting period the fee is supposed to purchase, so the dwell condition never even began to run.

POL-NS-06 then applies on its own terms: the effective in-geofence dwell is 0 seconds against a 300-second minimum for this zone class, a shortfall of 300 seconds computed on the longest_run_sec basis. POL-NS-06 is strict: where the corrected dwell is shorter than the POL-NS-01 minimum the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages. The fare_breakdown line to be refunded is the 4.00 SGD cancellation_fee that was charged at 13:10:32.

The driver cannot rescue the shortfall through POL-NS-06 limb (i), which is the only route to accumulating dwell across intervals and requires a present, populated traffic_advisory of an admissible type covering this pickup road and waiting window. The trace shows 0 in-geofence intervals and 0 runs for limb (i) to sum in the first place, and the only advisory on file, EV-ADVIS-09105-01, is MISSING with no payload and weight_multiplier 0.0, so limb (i) is unavailable on both counts. I disclose that artifact's impairment: it is tagged MISSING (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT) and carries no weight; I rely on its absence, which POL-GEN-02 makes citable, and not on any content.

This is precisely the wrong-entrance case POL-NS-03 governs rather than a no-show. The driver's trace shows him stationary for the required dwell at a point outside the POL-NS-02 arrival radius but well inside the 400 m ceiling: 34 fixes spanning 13:05:00 to 13:10:30, about 330 seconds, all at 219.77 m from trip_record.pickup and all at 0.0 km/h. The 400 m ceiling is the whole test and is measured from the pickup coordinates alone, so no venue-identity inference is needed. The driver did not arrive at the pickup point, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and the cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full.

On fault, POL-NS-03 limb (i) puts the loss on the driver and extinguishes his compensation. The rider named the sub-location in the chat: at 13:05:05, 'I am at Tower B ride-hail pickup, beside the blue sign.', and again at 13:06:35, 'That is the other entrance. Please come to Tower B.' The driver answered at 13:06:00 that he was 'waiting at the mall taxi stand' and, on his own trace, never moved from a fixed point 219.77 m away before cancelling at 13:10:30. Where the rider stated the correct entrance or tower and the driver did not move to it before cancelling, the driver bears the loss and receives no compensation.

Independently of POL-NS-03, POL-NS-04 exonerates the rider. Limb (a): the rider's 13:06:35 message is locating and coordinating content — it identifies the correct entrance and asks the driver to come to Tower B. Limb (b): the driver posted no reply within 120 seconds of that message, indeed posted nothing at all between 13:06:00 and his 13:10:30 cancellation, a silence of 235 seconds spanning the whole remaining wait, and trip_record.in_app_calls is an empty array, so no voice call defeats the clause either.

Limb (c) of POL-NS-04 is affirmatively satisfied, not undecidable. The rider track is available and all 16 rider fixes qualify: each is about 25.01 m from the pin (min 25.01 m, max 25.01 m, mean 25.01 m) and stationary at 0.0 km/h, so the rider's device sat inside the 150 m LARGE_VENUE rider_presence_radius_m for 100 per cent of qualifying fixes across the waiting window. The rider was at the pin, messaging, the entire time the driver held 219.77 m away.

Nothing in this bundle is impaired for policy purposes under POL-NS-08, so the distance figures are safe to decide on. The driver track holds 34 fixes at a 10-second sample interval with an empty gaps array and max_gap_sec 0.0, far above the 6-fix floor and with no 120-second gap; the trip_record arrived event at 13:05:20 lands on a fix timestamp, so there is no clock skew even approaching 90 seconds; the chat log holds 4 messages, matching trip_record.chat_message_count of 4, with no msg_id gap; and the 4.00 SGD cancellation_fee equals the greater of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee (4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (4.00), so there is no defect under limb (d).

POL-NS-07 compensates the driver only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it. Limb (b) fails on the trace and limb (c) fails on the zero-second dwell, and POL-NS-03 displaces the fee in any event, so the 3.20 SGD driver compensation floor does not arise and no part of the rider's fee should fund a driver payment.

Escalation under POL-NS-09 is not open on this record and should not be used to hold the fee instead of refunding it. The deciding artifacts all carry weight 1.0 so the confidence floor in limb (a) is not engaged; no two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence; limb (c) does not fire because rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0; and limb (d) does not fire because rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0. The case can and should be decided on the merits, and I note that a held fee is not a rider win.

On the remedy: the rider is the filing party, and fare_breakdown shows the 4.00 SGD cancellation fee with payment_status CHARGED, total_charged 4.00 and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so the rider presently carries the whole disputed amount. Under POL-GEN-03 a rider win is a ruling that leaves the rider not carrying that charge, and the whole contested amount is contested here — 4.00 SGD — so the correct outcome is FULL_REFUND of 4.00 SGD, with no split, since no limb of POL-NS-08 is engaged and no admissible artifacts conflict.

claims.text: The driver's own trace shows a genuine, unbroken wait: 34 fixes from 13:05:00 to 13:10:30, every one recording 0.0 km/h and a constant 219.8 m from the pin, with trace_distance_km of 0.00 — a stationary hold of 330 seconds, corroborated by trip_record.wait_time_min of 5.2. That hold is longer than the 300-second minimum dwell for a LARGE_VENUE pickup, so the defect in this case is one of location only, not of impatience: this was a full-timer wait at the venue, not a drive-by cancellation or a driver who took another job and came back.

POL-NS-05's false-arrival branch is not engaged and no false-arrival record is warranted against this driver. The trace places him stationary 219.8 m from the pin — inside the clause's own 300 m carve-out — with no motion at or above 15 km/h, and POL-NS-05 expressly states that a driver stationary within 300 m of the pin but outside the arrival radius is not caught by it and is decided under POL-NS-03. The 13:05:20 'arrived' marker accordingly cannot generate the POL-NS-05(ii) referral; the case belongs in POL-NS-03 as a wrong-entrance dispute.

The driver did not abandon the rider in the chat, so the rider cannot be exonerated under POL-NS-04. The rider's locating message ('I am at Tower B ride-hail pickup, beside the blue sign') was sent at 13:05:05 and the driver posted his own position ('I am waiting at the mall taxi stand') at 13:06:00 — 55 seconds later, well inside the 120-second window — so limb (b) of POL-NS-04 is not satisfied, no in-app call was required (trip_record.in_app_calls is empty), and the clause confirms that any residual mislocation is decided under POL-NS-03 rather than as a driver-side coordination failure.

The driver does not resist the refund of the SGD 4.00 fee, and this concession is made on his own evidence. His trace never places him inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius — minimum distance 219.8 m, qualifying_fix_count 0, longest qualifying run 0.0 seconds — so POL-NS-01 limb (b) is not met, the fee is not chargeable under that clause, and POL-NS-03 refunds it to the rider in full. The ledger amount (cancellation_fee 4.00, reconciling with the LARGE_VENUE zone fee and the RYDE_X tier fee under the POL-NS-01 resolution rule) is not disputed, and no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect arises.

On fault allocation under POL-NS-03 the driver accepts limb (i) and claims nothing under limb (ii). The rider named the sub-location in the chat — 'Tower B ride-hail pickup' at 13:05:05 and 'That is the other entrance. Please come to Tower B' at 13:06:35 — and the driver's own statement concedes he waited at a mall entrance and did not move to Tower B before cancelling at 13:10:30. The mislocation is therefore attributed to the driver rather than to pin ambiguity, notwithstanding the 3 registered pickup points recorded for this venue, and no compensation or pin-ambiguity goodwill is sought.

No adverse inference about the driver's conduct may be built on his record. Under POL-GEN-01 the lifetime counter driver_profile.prior_no_show_flags is context only and may not be substituted for the field the no-show clauses read; the citable field is driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d, which stands at 1 against 120 completed trips in 30 days — far below POL-NS-07's anti-farming threshold of 4 terminations and an 8 percent rate — so no charge-farming pattern can be found on this record.

ruling.explanation:
This dispute over the SGD 4.00 no-show cancellation fee on trip TRP-09105 is decided on the GPS trace (EV-GPS-09105) and the trip record (EV-TRIP-09105), both at full weight 1.0, and the outcome is a full refund to the rider.

The fee is not chargeable under POL-NS-01. Limb (b) requires the driver to be inside the pickup geofence at or before the 'arrived' event, and the arrival radius for this LARGE_VENUE pickup (NEX Serangoon, Tower B ride-hail pickup) is 120 m under the fee schedule. The driver's trace holds 34 fixes from 13:05:00 to 13:10:30, every one stationary at 0.0 km/h and 219.77 m from the pickup pin — about 100 m outside the radius — with 0 qualifying in-geofence fixes and a longest qualifying run of 0.0 seconds. Limb (c) fails with it: the effective in-geofence dwell is 0 seconds against the 300-second minimum for LARGE_VENUE. Both advocates accept this, and POL-NS-06 confirms the full refund of the 4.00 SGD cancellation_fee line actually charged at 13:10:32.

The case is therefore the wrong-entrance case governed by POL-NS-03. The driver was stationary for the required dwell — 330 seconds, 13:05:00 to 13:10:30 — at a point outside the 120 m arrival radius but well within the clause's 400 m ceiling (219.77 m), so the fee is refunded to the rider in full. No venue-identity inference is needed or made: the 400 m distance test decides from coordinates alone.

On fault allocation, POL-NS-03 limb (i) applies, so the driver receives no compensation. The rider named the sub-location in the chat log ('I am at Tower B ride-hail pickup, beside the blue sign.' at 13:05:05; 'That is the other entrance. Please come to Tower B.' at 13:06:35), and the driver, who answered at 13:06:00 that he was 'waiting at the mall taxi stand', never moved from his fixed 219.77 m point before cancelling at 13:10:30. Limb (ii) pin-ambiguity goodwill does not apply because the rider did specify the sub-location, notwithstanding the 3 registered pickup points. The POL-NS-07 figure of SGD 3.20 (80 percent of SGD 4.00) therefore does not arise, since POL-NS-01 is not satisfied and POL-NS-03 displaces it; the anti-farming check would not trip in any event (no_show_terminations_30d 1 against completed_trips_30d 120, a rate of 0.008, against thresholds of 4 and 0.08).

The rider's POL-NS-04 claims are noted but do not change the result. The rider's messages are locating content (limb (a)) and the rider's track shows all 16 qualifying fixes about 25.01 m from the pin, inside the 150 m LARGE_VENUE presence radius (limb (c)). Whether limb (b) is satisfied is left unresolved — the driver replied at 13:06:00, 55 seconds after the 13:05:05 message, though nothing after 13:06:35 — but the refund follows from POL-NS-03 either way.

No false-arrival referral is warranted. POL-NS-05 is not engaged: at the 13:05:20 arrival marker the driver was 219.77 m from the pin, inside the clause's own 300 m carve-out, and stationary at 0.0 km/h, so the marker cannot be false and no POL-NS-05(ii) record is produced. The empty referrals list reflects that no clause produces one here.

No escalation. POL-NS-08 does not apply: there is no clock skew (the 13:05:20 arrival event lands on a fix timestamp and the 13:10:30 cancellation matches the last fix), no trace gap (max_gap_sec 0.0, 34 fixes, well above the 6-fix floor), the chat log's 4 messages match trip_record.chat_message_count of 4 with no msg_id gap, and the 4.00 SGD cancellation fee equals the greater of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee (4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (4.00) under the resolution rule, so there is no limb (d) defect. Neither POL-NS-09(a) (confidence is above the 0.70 floor) nor limbs (b) to (e) fires; rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0 and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0.

Amounts: SGD 4.00 is refunded out of the SGD 4.00 charged (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00). Driver compensation is nil.

ruling.explanation:
Both sides end up agreeing that the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee cannot stand, and the recorded evidence shows why.

The driver's GPS trace (EV-GPS-09105, weight 1.0) holds 34 fixes from 13:05:00 to 13:10:30, every one at 0.0 km/h and 219.77 m from the Tower B pickup pin recorded in the trip record (EV-TRIP-09105, weight 1.0). This is a LARGE_VENUE pickup, so the POL-NS-02 arrival radius is 120 m. The driver never entered it: qualifying_fix_count is 0, longest qualifying in-geofence run is 0.0 seconds, and the minimum distance is 219.77 m, roughly 100 m outside the radius. POL-NS-01 limb (b) therefore fails outright, and the fee is not chargeable under that clause.

The case is the wrong-entrance situation POL-NS-03 governs, not a false-arrival case. The driver was stationary for the required 300-second dwell for this zone class — his trace spans about 330 seconds (13:05:00 to 13:10:30) — at a point outside the 120 m radius but well inside POL-NS-03's 400 m ceiling (219.77 m), so POL-NS-03 refunds the cancellation fee to the rider in full. On fault allocation, the rider named the correct sub-location in the chat log (EV-CHAT-09105, weight 1.0): 'I am at Tower B ride-hail pickup, beside the blue sign.' at 13:05:05 and 'That is the other entrance. Please come to Tower B.' at 13:06:35. The driver did not move to Tower B before cancelling at 13:10:30, and his own statement concedes he 'waited at a mall entrance for the full timer but did not move to Tower B.' POL-NS-03 limb (i) therefore puts the loss on the driver. No compensation and no pin-ambiguity goodwill (limb (ii)) is payable, notwithstanding the 3 registered pickup points recorded for this venue, because the rider specified the tower.

No false-arrival referral arises. The driver was stationary within POL-NS-05's own 300 m carve-out (219.77 m) at 0.0 km/h, and that clause expressly leaves a driver in his position to POL-NS-03; the 13:05:20 'arrived' marker therefore generates no POL-NS-05(ii) record and the referrals list is empty. The parties' remaining arguments do not change the result. POL-NS-06 points the same way (0-second in-geofence dwell against a 300-second minimum, a 300-second shortfall) but yields to POL-NS-03. POL-NS-04 is disputed but moot: the driver answered the 13:05:05 message 55 seconds later, yet left the rider's 13:06:35 request unanswered for the remaining 235 seconds — either way POL-NS-03 already refunds the fee in full with no compensation, so the clause decides nothing further. POL-NS-07's SGD 3.20 driver compensation does not arise because POL-NS-01 is not satisfied and POL-NS-03 displaces it; in any event the anti-farming check would not trip (no_show_terminations_30d of 1 against 120 completed trips in 30 days).

On the record's integrity: the missing traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-09105-01, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) removes only POL-NS-06 limb (i), which is not needed here, and no POL-NS-08 limb is engaged — the trace has an empty gaps array and max_gap_sec 0.0 across 34 fixes, the chat log holds the 4 messages the trip record counts, the arrival marker lands on a fix timestamp with no skew, and the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee equals the greater of the LARGE_VENUE zone fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00), so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect. Every artifact carrying the deciding facts has weight 1.0, so confidence is not capped below 1.0, and no POL-NS-09 trigger fires: there is no unresolved contradiction, no second same-pair dispute (both counterparty counters are 0), no anti-farming pattern, and no abuse counter (rider no_show_disputes_30d is 0). The case is decided, not escalated, and the fee is refunded rather than held. Profile fields not named by a clause (prior_no_show_flags, prior_disputes_filed, ratings and the like) are context only under POL-GEN-01 and carry no adverse finding against either party.

Outcome: the disputed SGD 4.00 cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full; no driver compensation is payable.

Rider and driver: the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full.

Why the fee is not chargeable. POL-NS-01 charges a no-show fee only if all four limbs hold. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-09105, weight 1.0) places the driver at 219.77 m from the pickup pin (min = mean = max = 219.77 m) at 0.0 km/h across 34 fixes from 13:05:00 to 13:10:30. For this LARGE_VENUE pickup (trip record EV-TRIP-09105) the POL-NS-02 arrival radius is 120 m, so he was never inside the geofence: qualifying_fix_count 0 and longest qualifying in-geofence run 0.0 s. Limbs (b) and (c) both fail.

Which clause decides. The driver's hold was at 219.77 m — outside the 120 m arrival radius, inside POL-NS-03's 400 m ceiling — and stationary for 330 seconds (13:05:00 to 13:10:30), above the 300-second minimum for LARGE_VENUE. POL-NS-03 therefore governs: the driver did not arrive at the pickup point, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and the fee is refunded in full. POL-NS-06 reaches the same result on the zero-second in-geofence dwell (shortfall 300 s), and its limb (i) cannot be invoked because the only traffic advisory, EV-ADVIS-09105-01, is MISSING with weight 0.0 — its absence is citable but it carries no content. The rider's separate POL-NS-04 argument is answered together with the driver's contrary one: the driver's 13:06:00 reply answered the 13:05:05 message inside 120 s, but the rider's further locating message at 13:06:35 went unanswered (no reply, and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty) before the 13:10:30 cancellation, and the rider's device sat 25.01 m from the pin, well inside the 150 m LARGE_VENUE rider radius. POL-NS-04 thus also exonerates the rider, but it is a supporting route, not a necessary one — every route gives the same money. POL-NS-05 is not engaged: the driver was stationary 219.77 m from the pin at 0.0 km/h, inside the clause's own 300 m carve-out, so no false-arrival record or referral arises.

Driver compensation: none. Under POL-NS-03 limb (i) the chat log (EV-CHAT-09105) shows the rider named the sub-location — 'I am at Tower B ride-hail pickup, beside the blue sign' at 13:05:05 and 'That is the other entrance. Please come to Tower B' at 13:06:35 — and the driver, on his own counterparty statement and his own trace, waited at a mall entrance and did not move to Tower B before cancelling at 13:10:30. The driver bears the loss. Limb (ii) pin-ambiguity goodwill is not available because a sub-location was specified. POL-NS-07 compensation is not reached: POL-NS-01 is not satisfied in full and POL-NS-03, POL-NS-04 and POL-NS-06 displace it, and in any event the anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d is 1 against completed_trips_30d of 120, far below 4 terminations and an 8% rate).

Amount. fare_breakdown (EV-FARE-09105) shows cancellation_fee 4.00, total_charged 4.00, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so the rider presently carries the whole contested sum. The figure reconciles under the fee_schedule resolution rule: the greater of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee (4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (4.00) is 4.00, so no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect arises.

Confidence and escalation. No POL-NS-08 limb is engaged: the trace has no gap (max_gap_sec 0.0, 34 fixes, rider_track present), no clock skew beyond 90 s (the 13:05:20 arrived marker lands on a fix), the chat holds all 4 messages its msg_id sequence and trip_record.chat_message_count record, and the fare line reconciles. The deciding facts are carried by artifacts at weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0. No POL-NS-09 limb fires: confidence is above the 0.70 floor, no two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence (the 'arrived' marker and the 219.77 m position are the wrong-entrance situation POL-NS-03 resolves), both disputes_with_counterparty_90d counters are 0, and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0. The case is decided on the merits, so the fee is refunded rather than held.

Rider and driver: the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee charged at 13:10:32 is refunded to the rider in full, and no driver compensation is payable.

The fee can only stand if all four conditions in POL-NS-01 hold, and condition (b) does not. The GPS trace records 34 driver fixes between 13:05:00 and 13:10:30, every one 219.77 m from the Tower B pickup pin and every one at 0.0 km/h. The arrival radius for this large-venue pickup is 120 m, so the trace never places the driver inside it: the qualifying in-geofence fix count is zero. Condition (c) fails too — the in-geofence dwell is 0 seconds against the 300-second minimum. The fee is therefore not chargeable under POL-NS-01, and the rider's claim that the charge is unsupported is upheld.

This is a wrong-entrance case, so POL-NS-03 governs the remedy. The driver held position 219.77 m from the pin — outside the 120 m arrival radius but inside the 400 m ceiling — for 330 seconds (13:05:00 to 13:10:30), longer than the 300-second required dwell, so POL-NS-03 refunds the fee in full. On who absorbs the cost, the chat log decides: the rider named the sub-location twice (13:05:05 'I am at Tower B ride-hail pickup, beside the blue sign'; 13:06:35 'That is the other entrance. Please come to Tower B'), while the driver replied at 13:06:00 that he was at the mall taxi stand and, by his own statement and his own trace, never moved to Tower B before cancelling. Under POL-NS-03(i) the driver bears the loss and receives no compensation; the pin-ambiguity goodwill in POL-NS-03(ii) is unavailable because the rider did specify the sub-location. No POL-NS-07 compensation arises either, because it requires POL-NS-01 to be satisfied in full and POL-NS-03 displaces it.

The rider's further argument under POL-NS-04 is not reached on its own terms: the driver replied at 13:06:00, 55 seconds after the rider's 13:05:05 locating message, so limb (b)'s 120-second silence is not met and the residual mislocation is decided under POL-NS-03. Either route produces the same full refund, so nothing turns on it.

The false-arrival branch of POL-NS-05 is not engaged: the driver was stationary within the clause's 300 m carve-out, so no false-arrival referral is recorded. Nothing in the bundle is impaired under POL-NS-08 — the trace has no gaps (34 fixes, max_gap_sec 0.0), the chat log's 4 messages match trip_record.chat_message_count, the arrived event lands on a fix timestamp, and the 4.00 SGD fee equals the greater of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee (4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (4.00). No POL-NS-09 trigger fires, so the case is decided on the merits rather than escalated.

On the driver's profile point, POL-GEN-01 correctly makes the lifetime prior_no_show_flags counter context only; the citable no_show_terminations_30d stands at 1 against 120 completed trips, far below the POL-NS-07 anti-farming thresholds, so no adverse inference is drawn from the driver's record.

Amount: the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee (fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee 4.00, total_charged 4.00, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00) is returned to the rider in full. The deciding facts rest on artifacts of full weight, so confidence is 0.95.
